sections.title: باب 5 — متن (8)

paras.text: First of all the problem is identified, that is, what the problem is and what the importance of this problem is. The establishment of a stable society is the responsibility of all of us. Before the problem raises its head and becomes complicated, there is a need to understand it and identify it. For example, weaknesses in the examination system are an important problem.
paras.urdu: سب سے پہلے مسئلہ (Problem) کی نشاندہی کی جاتی ہے کہ مسئلہ کیا ہے اور یہ کہ اِس مسئلے کی اہمیت کیا ہے۔ ایک مستحکم معاشرہ کا قیام ہم سب کی ذمہ داری ہے۔ اِس سے پہلے کہ مسئلہ سر اُٹھا کر پیچیدہ ہو جائے اُسے سمجھنے اور اِسکی نشاندہی کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔ مثال کے طور پر اِمتحانی نظام میں خامیاں ایک اہم مسئلہ ہے۔
paras.pashto: تر ټولو لومړی ستونزه (Problem) پېژندل کېږي چې ستونزه څه ده او د دې ستونزې اهمیت څه دی. د یوې باثباته ټولنې جوړول زموږ د ټولو مسؤلیت دی. مخکې له دې چې ستونزه سر راپورته کړي او پېچلې شي، د پوهېدو او پېژندلو اړتیا یې وي. د بېلګې په توګه په ازموینیز نظام کې نیمګړتیاوې یوه مهمه ستونزه ده.

paras.text: 2. Three or four possible solutions of the problem:
paras.urdu: ۲۔ مسئلے کے ممکنہ تین چار حل:
paras.pashto: ۲. د ستونزې درې څلور شوني حلونه:

paras.text: Now at least three or four possible solution hypotheses of this problem will have to be presented. For example, for reform in the examination system the following possible solution hypotheses are:
paras.urdu: اب اِس مسئلے کے کم از کم تین چار ممکنہ حل مفروضے (Hypotheses) پیش کرنے ہونگے۔ مثال کے طور پر اِمتحانی نظام میں اِصلاح کیلئے درج ذیل ممکنہ حل مفروضے ہیں:
paras.pashto: اوس باید د دې ستونزې لږ تر لږه درې څلور شوني حل فرضیې (Hypotheses) وړاندې شي. د بېلګې په توګه په ازموینیز نظام کې د اصلاح لپاره لاندې شونې حل فرضیې دي:

paras.text: (a) Every month the teacher prepares a review report of his pupils, and numbers be fixed for these reports.
paras.urdu: الف۔ ہر مہینے اُستاد اپنے شاگردوں کی جائزہ رپورٹ تیار کرے اور اُسی رپورٹوں کے نمبرز مقرر کئے جائیں۔
paras.pashto: (الف) هره میاشت ښوونکی د خپلو زده‌کوونکو د کتنې راپور چمتو کړي او د همدې راپورونو نمرې وټاکل شي.

paras.text: (b) Corrupt employees be removed from the examining institutions and employees of good reputation be encouraged. Professional people be discouraged and kept away from examination duties. Honest people be appointed examiners and encouraged.
paras.urdu: ب۔ اِمتحان لینے والے اِداروں سے بدعنوان ملازمین کو نکالا جائے اور اچھی شہرت کے ملازمین کی حوصلہ افزائی کی جائے۔ پیشہ ور لوگوں کی حوصلہ شکنی کی جائے اور انہیں اِمتحانی ڈیوٹیوں سے دور رکھا جائے۔ دیانتدار لوگوں کو ممتحن مقرر کیا جائے اور اُن کی حوصلہ افزائی ہو۔
paras.pashto: (ب) له ازموینه اخیستونکو ادارو فاسد کارکوونکي وایستل شي او ښه شهرت لرونکي کارکوونکي وهڅول شي. مسلکي (کاروباري) کسان ونه هڅول شي او له ازموینیزو دندو لرې وساتل شي. صادق کسان ممتحن وټاکل شي او وهڅول شي.

paras.text: (c) The system of checking at examination centres be made effective. The process of preparing papers and checking be made effective, and honest teachers be employed to end the possibilities of injustice in it.
paras.urdu: ج۔ اِمتحانی مراکز پر جانچ پڑتال کا نظام مؤثر بنایا جائے۔ پرچہ جات کی تیاری اور چیکنگ کا عمل مؤثر بنایا جائے اور اِس میں حق تلفی کے اِمکانات ختم کرنے کیلئے دیانتدار اساتذہ سے کام لیا جائے۔
paras.pashto: (ج) په ازموینیزو مرکزونو کې د څارنې نظام اغېزمن شي. د پوښتنپاڼو د چمتو کولو او کتنې بهیر اغېزمن شي او په کې د حق تلفۍ د امکاناتو د ختمولو لپاره له صادقو ښوونکو کار واخیستل شي.

paras.text: (d) The incentives of examination staff be increased satisfactorily.
paras.urdu: د۔ اِمتحانی عملہ کی مراعات میں خاطر خواہ اضافہ ہو۔
paras.pashto: (د) د ازموینیزو کارکوونکو امتیازات دې د پام وړ زیات شي.

paras.text: 3. Advantages and disadvantages of every possible solution:
paras.urdu: ۳۔ ہر ممکنہ حل کے فوائد و نقائص:
paras.pashto: ۳. د هر شوني حل ګټې او نیمګړتیاوې:

paras.text: To find the best solution a detailed critical review of every possible solution has to be taken. For example, every month the teacher prepares a review report of his pupils and numbers are fixed for these reports. Its benefit will be that the real ability of the child can be estimated. At the very basic level a correct review can also be taken. The teacher’s dignity too will not be hurt. Students too will be saved from troubles. Its disadvantage is that the teacher can work by personal liking and disliking, but even so its possibilities are less. The second solution is that corrupt staff be discouraged and honest people be encouraged. This too is a good thing …
paras.urdu: بہترین حل تلاش کرنے کیلئے ہر ممکنہ حل کا تفصیلی تنقیدی جائزہ لینا پڑتا ہے۔ مثال کے طور پر ہر مہینے اُستاد اپنے شاگردوں کی جائزہ رپورٹ تیار کرے اور اُسی رپورٹوں کے نمبرز مقرر کئے جائیں۔ اِس کا فائدہ یہ ہوگا کہ اِس سے بچے کی اصل قابلیت کا اندازہ ہو سکے گا۔ بالکل بنیادی سطح پر صحیح جائزہ بھی لیا جا سکے گا۔ اُستاد کا وقار بھی مجروح نہیں ہوگا۔ طلبہ و طالبات بھی پریشانیوں سے بچ جائیں گے۔ اِس کا نقصان یہ ہے کہ اُستاد ذاتی پسند و ناپسند سے کام لے سکتا ہے لیکن پھر بھی اِس کے اِمکانات کم ہیں۔ دوسرا حل یہ ہے کہ بدعنوان عملہ کی حوصلہ شکنی اور دیانتدار لوگوں کی حوصلہ افزائی ہو۔ یہ بھی اچھی بات ہے۔
paras.pashto: د غوره حل د موندلو لپاره د هر شوني حل تفصیلي انتقادي کتنه پکار ده. د بېلګې په توګه هره میاشت ښوونکی د خپلو زده‌کوونکو د کتنې راپور چمتو کړي او د همدې راپورونو نمرې وټاکل شي. ګټه به یې دا وي چې د ماشوم اصلي وړتیا به اټکل شي. په بالکل بنسټیزه کچه به سمه کتنه هم وشي. د ښوونکي وقار به هم زیانمن نه شي. زده‌کوونکي هلکان او نجونې به هم له ستونزو وژغورل شي. زیان یې دا دی چې ښوونکی له شخصي خوښې او ناخوښۍ کار اخیستلی شي، خو بیا هم امکانات یې لږ دي. دویم حل دا دی چې فاسد کارکوونکي ونه هڅول شي او صادق کسان وهڅول شي. دا هم ښه خبره ده …

sections.theory:
1. Identification of the problem:

First of all the problem is identified, that is, what the problem is and what the importance of this problem is. The establishment of a stable society is the responsibility of all of us. Before the problem raises its head and becomes complicated, there is a need to understand it and identify it. For example, weaknesses in the examination system are an important problem.

2. Three or four possible solutions of the problem:

Now at least three or four possible solution hypotheses of this problem will have to be presented. For example, for reform in the examination system the following possible solution hypotheses are:

(a) Every month the teacher prepares a review report of his pupils, and numbers be fixed for these reports.

(b) Corrupt employees be removed from the examining institutions and employees of good reputation be encouraged. Professional people be discouraged and kept away from examination duties. Honest people be appointed examiners and encouraged.

(c) The system of checking at examination centres be made effective. The process of preparing papers and checking be made effective, and honest teachers be employed to end the possibilities of injustice in it.

(d) The incentives of examination staff be increased satisfactorily.

3. Advantages and disadvantages of every possible solution:

To find the best solution a detailed critical review of every possible solution has to be taken. For example, every month the teacher prepares a review report of his pupils and numbers are fixed for these reports. Its benefit will be that the real ability of the child can be estimated. At the very basic level a correct review can also be taken. The teacher’s dignity too will not be hurt. Students too will be saved from troubles. Its disadvantage is that the teacher can work by personal liking and disliking, but even so its possibilities are less. The second solution is that corrupt staff be discouraged and honest people be encouraged. This too is a good thing …

1. Identification of the problem:

First of all the problem is identified, that is, what the problem is and what the importance of this problem is. The establishment of a stable society is the responsibility of all of us. Before the problem raises its head and becomes complicated, there is a need to understand it and identify it. For example, weaknesses in the examination system are an important problem.

2. Three or four possible solutions of the problem:

Now at least three or four possible solution hypotheses of this problem will have to be presented. For example, for reform in the examination system the following possible solution hypotheses are:

(a) Every month the teacher prepares a review report of his pupils, and numbers be fixed for these reports.

(b) Corrupt employees be removed from the examining institutions and employees of good reputation be encouraged. Professional people be discouraged and kept away from examination duties. Honest people be appointed examiners and encouraged.

(c) The system of checking at examination centres be made effective. The process of preparing papers and checking be made effective, and honest teachers be employed to end the possibilities of injustice in it.

(d) The incentives of examination staff be increased satisfactorily.

3. Advantages and disadvantages of every possible solution:

To find the best solution a detailed critical review of every possible solution has to be taken. For example, every month the teacher prepares a review report of his pupils and numbers are fixed for these reports. Its benefit will be that the real ability of the child can be estimated. At the very basic level a correct review can also be taken. The teacher’s dignity too will not be hurt. Students too will be saved from troubles. Its disadvantage is that the teacher can work by personal liking and disliking, but even so its possibilities are less. The second solution is that corrupt staff be discouraged and honest people be encouraged. This too is a good thing …

4. Recommendation of the best solution:

After taking a thorough critical review of all the proposals, it can be decided what the best solution to the problem is. Reviewing the said proposals, it can be said that proposal number one is more useful.

Methods to Disseminate Information

Different methods are used for the dissemination of information and news, of which the important ones are the following:

Newsletters

By newsletter is meant that published information or news which relates to the interests of some particular group. This kind of information is spread among the members and employees of society or institutions at fixed times. In accordance with this method, continuous information is provided to the members of interest groups and organisations about the activities of their organisation and its interests etc. Most institutions provide the general public with information about that institution and its activities, published after a particular period.

By adopting this kind of policy good people will come into the field, because they will be encouraged. But this is a difficult act, and testing every teacher is not so easy. Another proposal is to make the system of checking and inspection effective. Its benefit is that errors will be fewer and no one’s rights will be violated. Its disadvantage is that in the early stages of the examination this solution may perhaps not prove so effective. The last solution is that the incentives of the examination staff be increased satisfactorily. Its good point is that the staff will be financially satisfied and improvement will come in the examination system. Its weakness is that if, despite incentives, they do not desist, then this system will again remain a victim of failure and corruption.

4. Recommendation of the best solution:

After taking a thorough critical review of all the proposals, it can be decided what the best solution to the problem is. Reviewing the said proposals, it can be said that proposal number one is more useful.

Methods to Disseminate Information

Different methods are used for the dissemination of information and news, of which the important ones are the following:

Newsletters

By newsletter is meant that published information or news which relates to the interests of some particular group. This kind of information is spread among the members and employees of society or institutions at fixed times. In accordance with this method, continuous information is provided to the members of interest groups and organisations about the activities of their organisation and its interests etc. Most institutions provide the general public with information about that institution and its activities, published after a particular period.

Bulletin Boards

A bulletin is called a thematic news item. Any official announcement too is called a bulletin. Bulletin boards can be taken in two senses. A simple and common meaning is that any notice or information is pinned on the notice board of an institution …

بُلیٹن یک موضوعی خبر یا خبروں کو کہا جاتا ہے۔ کسی سرکاری اعلان کو بھی بُلیٹن کہا جاتا ہے۔ بُلیٹن بورڈز کو دو معنوں میں لیا جا سکتا ہے۔ ایک سادہ اور عام معنی یہ ہے کہ کسی اِطلاع یا معلومات کو اِدارے کے نوٹس بورڈ پر پِن کر کے لگایا جاتا …
